t: This is the clock tower at the north end of the Palace of Westminster, the one everyone calls Big Ben. Strictly, that nickname belongs to the Great Bell, and the clock is a striking clock with five bells. The tower was first called the Clock Tower. In 2012 it was renamed the Elizabeth Tower to mark the Diamond Jubilee of Queen Elizabeth II, whose seventy-year reign was the longest of any British monarch. Charles Barry is best known for rebuilding the Palace of Westminster, and Augustus Pugin, a pioneer of the Gothic Revival, is credited with its interior and this tower.
